items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-10-14
items.q: And he was playing trumpet. Used to get plenty of weight. Plenty of weight. But he used to come at my house and get them and my mom used to tell him, you can take them if you're going to bring them back home.

ctx.x: They're alike. They had some nice times in the band. They had, Zeddy Johnson was playing saxophone with them too. And a fellow by the name of Tom Copeland lived down around Maurice Durand House. He was playing bass. And Albert Francis' wife was playing piano. Albert Francis drummer, his wife was playing piano in his band. And this fellow played trumpet, what they call Cuckoo. I think his right name is Tavern. Yeah. I got a picture of him home.
